description: Opaque handle for a key in the afw_crypto process keystore. keyId is a random 64-bit capability within the process only (not multi-tenant isolation). Raw key material is not exposed when extractable is false.

algorithm.description: Normalized registry algorithm name (e.g. AES-GCM, HMAC-SHA-256).

extractable.description: If true, crypto_export_key may return raw key octets.

length.description: Bit length when known (e.g. 128 or 256 for AES-GCM).

usages.description: Subset of encrypt, decrypt, sign, verify, derive.
